component.name: Chatmon
component.summary: A desktop companion that answers with your AI and keeps an eye on your coding agents

description.p: A little creature lives along the bottom of your screen: an electric penguin, a fire red panda, a ghost rabbit, a fairy axolotl or a leaf pangolin. Click it and ask anything; it answers with the AI you already use, a command-line tool you're signed in to, a model server on your own computer, or an API.
It thinks while your coding agents work, flaps when one needs your approval, and hops when one is done. It also keeps reminders and timers, nudges you to take breaks, and stays out of your way.
